items.text: Mtalo ghwa wandu werewurieghe kufuma wubarishonyi

Wandu wengi weredwaloghe wunyika wikafuma isanga ja Babuloni; wikawuya Jerusalemu na Juda kula mundu mzinyi kwake. Wandu wa nyumba rawo weredueghe wubarishonyi Babuloni kufuma Nebukadnezari wawidwa Babuloni sa wafungwa.
Vilongozi vawo werekoghe Zerubabeli, Jeshua, Nehemia, Seraia, Reelaia, Mordekai, Bilshani, Mispari, Bigvai, Rehumu, na Baana.
Ughu nigho mtalo ghwa wandu wa womi wa wandu wa Israeli werewurieghe kufuma wubarishonyi.
Kichuku cha Paroshi, wandu elfu iwi ighana jimweri na mirongo mfungade na wawi.
Kichuku cha Shefatia, wandu maghana adadu na mirongo mfungade na wawi.
Kichuku cha Ara, wandu maghana mfungade na mirongo mfungade na wasanu.
Kichuku cha Pahath-moabu wa kivalwa cha Jeshua na Joabu, wandu elfu iwi maghana wunyanya na ikumi na wawi.
Kichuku cha Elamu, wandu elfu imweri maghana awi na mirongo misanu na bana.
Kichuku cha Zatu, wandu maghana ikenda na mirongo ina na wasanu.
Kichuku cha Zakai, wandu maghana mfungade na mirongo irandadu.
Kichuku cha Bani, wandu maghana arandadu na mirongo ina na wawi.
Kichuku cha Bebai, wandu maghana arandadu na mirongo iwi na wadadu.
Kichuku cha Azgadi, wandu elfu imweri maghana awi na mirongo iwi na wawi.
Kichuku cha Adonikamu, wandu maghana arandadu na mirongo irandadu na warandadu.
Kichuku cha Bigvai, wandu elfu iwi na mirongo misanu na warandadu.
Kichuku cha Adini wandu maghana ana na mirongo misanu na bana.
Kichuku cha Ateri wa nyumba ya Hezekia, wandu mirongo ikenda na wunyanya.
Kichuku cha Bezai, wandu maghana adadu na mirongo iwi na wadadu.
Kichuku cha Jora, wandu ighana na ikumi na wawi.
Kichuku cha Hashumu wandu maghana awi na mirongo iwi na wadadu.
Kichuku cha Gibari wandu mirongo ikenda na wasanu.
Awa ni wandu werewurieghe, awo weke wawae werekoghe wikikaia Bethlehemu, wandu ighana na mirongo iwi na wadadu.
Netofa, wandu mirongo misanu na warandadu.
Anathothi, wandu ighana na mirongo iwi na wunyanya.
Azmawethi, wandu mirongo ina na wawi.
Kiriath-jearimu, Kefira na Beerothi wandu maghana mfungade na mirongo ina na wadadu.
Rama na Geba wandu maghana arandadu na mirongo iwi na umweri.
Mikmashi wandu ighana na mirongo iwi na wawi.
Betheli na Ai wandu maghana awi na mirongo iwi na wadadu.
Nebo, wandu mirongo misanu na wawi.
Magbishi wandu ighana na mirongo misanu na warandadu.
Elamu ya kawi, wandu elfu imweri maghana awi na mirongo misanu na bana.
Harimu wandu maghana adadu na mirongo iwi.
Lodi, Hadidi na Ono, wandu maghana mfungade na mirongo iwi na wasanu.
Jeriko, wandu maghana adadu na mirongo ina na wasanu.
Senaa, wandu elfu idadu maghana arandadu na mirongo idadu.
Ughu ni mtalo ghwa kichuku cha wakohani werewurieghe: Kichuku cha Jedaia, wa kivalwa cha Jeshua maghana ikenda mirongo mfungade na wadadu.
Kichuku cha Imeri elfu imweri na mirongo misanu na wawi.
Kichuku cha Pashuri, elfu imweri maghana awi na mirongo ina na mfungade.
Kichuku cha Harimu, elfu imweri na ikumi na mfungade.
Kichuku cha Walawi werewurieghe kufuma wubarishonyi ni: Kichuku cha Jeshua na Kadmieli, kivalwa cha Hodavia, wandu mirongo mfungade na wawi.
Wabori wa Hekalunyi, Kivalwa cha Asafu, wandu ighana na mirongo iwi na wunyanya.
Walindiri wa Hekalu kichuku cha Shalumu, Ateri, Talmoni, Akubu, Hatita, na Shobai, wandu ighana na mirongo idadu na ikenda wose chiaimweri.
Kichuku cha wadumiki wa Hekalunyi werewurieghe kufuma wubarishonyi ni Ziha, Hasufu, Tabaothi,
Kerosi, Siaha, Padoni,
Lebana, Hagaba, Akubu,
Hagabu, Shamlai, Hanani,
Gideli, Gahari, Reaia,
Rezini, Nekoda, Gazamu,
Uza, Pasea, Besai,
Asina, Meumimu, Nefisimu,
Bakibuki, Hakufa, Harihuri,
Basluthi, Mehida, Harisha,
Barkosi, Sisera, Tema,
Nezia, na Hatifa.
Kichuku cha wadumiki wa Solomoni werewurieghe kufuma wubarishonyi Sotai, Haseferethi, Peruda,
Jaala, Darkoni, Gideli,
Shefatia, Hatili, Pokerethi-hazebaimu, na Ami.
Kichuku chose cha wadumiki wa Hekalunyi na Kichuku cha wadumiki wa Solomoni, werekoghe wandu maghana adadu na mirongo ikenda na wawi.
Awa nawo ni wandu werefumieghe Tel-mela, Tel-harsha, Kerubu, Adani, na Imeri, hata ngera saki ndeweredimieghe kughora worinyi kivalwa cha weke ndee angu kivalwa chawo na seji werekoghe Waisraeli.
Kichuku cha Delaia, na cha Tobia, na kivalwa cha Nakoda; wandu maghana arandadu na mirongo misanu na wawi.

Awa wakohani wokoni werewurieghe kufuma wubarishonyi: Kichuku cha Habaia, Kichuku cha Hakozi, na Kichuku cha Barzilai (mndumu wa Kichuku cha Barzilai orelowueghe mwai wa Barzilai Mgileadi nao ukawangwa irina ja mghosi wake Barzilai.)
Awa werelolieghe andenyi ya maandiko gha vichuku ngera waandikilo ela wikasowa; nawo wikaghirilwa wukohani wikitalwa kukaia wiseelie.
M'baa wa isanga ja Wayahudi ukawizera wisekepata ifungu jingi ja vindo vifunyiro kwa Mlungu hata upatike mkohani udimagha kulola malagho kwa Urimu na Thumimu.
Ikwanyiko jose ja wandu wiwurie kufuma wubarishonyi jerekoghe wandu mirongo ina na wawi elfu maghana adadu na mirongo irandadu,
wabonyi kazi wawo wa womi na wa waka werekoghe elfu mfungade, maghana adadu, na mirongo idadu na mfungade; wabori wa womi na wa waka werekoghe maghana awi.
Werekoghe na farasi maghana mfungade na mirongo idadu na irandadu; nyumbu maghana awi mirongo ina na isanu;
ngamila maghana ana mirongo idadu na isanu; na punda elfu irandadu maghana mfungade na mirongo iwi.
Wandu wiendavika Hekalunyi kwa BWANA Jerusalemu, vilongozi vimu va vichuku werefunyireghe mafunyo kwa ngolo kwa wundu ghoiagha Hekalu andu kwaro.
Werefunyireghe kwa wundu ghwa iyo kazi seji weredimieghe, na mtalo ghwaro ghukakaia kilo maghana masanu ra dhahabu, kilo elfu iwi na maghana wunyanya ra feza, na marwao ighana gha wakohani.

Wakohani, Walawi, na wandu wamu werekaieghe andenyi na mbai mbai ya Jerusalemu; wabori, walindiri wa Hekalu na wadumiki wa hekalunyi wikakaia mizinyi ya kaavui, na Waisraeli wose werekaieghe andu weke wawae werekoghe.
